name: Pan pipes
group: Things people make > Toys > Make music with it > Blow into it

features.claim: It is made of several pipes that get longer one after another.
features.quote: consisting of multiple pipes of gradually increasing length (and occasionally girth)

features.claim: The pipes are placed side by side in a row and bound together.
features.quote: Then, Pan cut several reeds, placed them in parallel one next to the other, and bound them together to make a melodic musical instrument.

features.claim: In the Romanian style the pipes are arranged in a curved row and glued solidly together.
features.quote: The Romanian pan flute has the pipes arranged in a curved array, solidly glued together, unlike Andean versions, which are usually tied together.

second_reading.claim: The pipes are usually made of bamboo, giant cane or local reeds.
second_reading.quote: The pipes are typically made from bamboo, giant cane, or local reeds.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it

second_reading.claim: The pipes can also be made of wood, plastic, metal or clay.
second_reading.quote: Other materials include wood, plastic, metal, and clay.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it

second_reading.claim: Each pipe is stopped up at one end.
second_reading.quote: The pan flute's tubes are stopped at one end, at which the standing wave is reflected giving a note an octave lower than that produced by an open pipe of equal length.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it

second_reading.claim: You blow across the open end of the pipes to play it.
second_reading.quote: The pan flute is played by blowing horizontally across an open end against the sharp inner edge of the pipes.
second_reading.why: a picture could not show it
